# Proverbs 2 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 2:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | To-make-attentive to-wisdom your-ear, you-incline your-heart to-understanding, |
| LOGOS | Making your ear attentive to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding; |
| PNEUMA | If you tune your ears to wisdom and open your mind to understanding, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
